name: ServiceSell × FinBridge
tagline: Cubiczan agentic services. Two skins. Propose, challenge, lock.
description: Cubiczan agentic-services console for mid-market blue-collar operators ($20M–$500M). ServiceSell deploys agents in dispatch, after-hours booking, and job-cost. FinBridge deploys agents on quote-to-cash, job-cost, and cash beyond the bookkeeper. Same tools, same CHP human-lock spine, different theme and copy. Mention #servicesell or #finbridge.
_comment_listing: Listing logo/screenshots are also stored on the AnnaApp row via the Developer Console Listing tab (not the version manifest). Source files live in docs/listing/. See docs/ANNA-RESUBMIT.md.
_comment_bundled_executas: anna-app apps publish publishes each bundled Executa first, then substitutes server-minted tool_ids into every bundled:<handle> reference in manifest.json (in memory — the file on disk is never mutated) and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js. Do not hardcode platform tool_ids such as tool-cubiczan-cubiczan-chp-yexs252k.
